title: SFI26: 50% of Window 2 budget now allocated

content.text: As part of our commitment to keep you informed about the progress of the Sustainable Farming Incentive 2026 (SFI26), we said we would publish updates as funding is allocated.
We can confirm that 50% of the £233 million budget for Window 2 has now been allocated.
We will continue to monitor demand closely and intend to publish further updates when approximately 75% of the £233 million Window 2 budget has been allocated.
Please subscribe to the Farming Blog to receive an email notification when we provide further updates on budget allocation.

Window 2 is open to farmers and land managers who, at the point they start an application:
This includes those with existing ELM revenue agreements that expire by the end of February 2027.
You can find the full eligibility criteria for Window 2 in the SFI26 scheme rules and guidance on GOV.UK.
Farmers and land managers who were eligible in Window 1 but didn’t submit an application can also apply in Window 2.
Read section 7 ‘Get ready to apply’ in the SFI26 scheme rules and guidance for more information.
The RPA continues to process applications as quickly and efficiently as possible.
Applications are processed in the order in which they were submitted. Some applications require additional checks and can therefore take longer to assess.
Applications are progressing well overall. We will provide an update on when successful applicants can expect to receive their agreement offer in due course.
